title: Thurston Lava Tube Wooden Sign in Hawaii, 1949 B&W Snapshot Photo
location: Hawaii Volcanoes National Park, Hawaii, USA
description: A close-up black and white photograph of a carved rustic wooden trail sign marking the entrance to the Thurston Lava Tube (Keanakakina / Nāhuku) in Hawaii Volcanoes National Park, surrounded by native rainforest fern foliage. Taken during a trip to the Hawaiian Islands in May 1949, capturing mid-20th-century national park signage and tourism.
